note: The per_transaction_assessment array is empty because no transactions executed. Evidence completeness is calculated only over a defined EXECUTED population (Section E). The executed population is 0; therefore no per-transaction assessment is possible. The 16 planned scenarios are recorded as NOT_APPLICABLE for evidence-completeness (not EVIDENCE_MISSING) because they did not execute — EVIDENCE_MISSING would presuppose an execution that failed to produce evidence, which is not the case here.
